protocol: baseline -> single PodChaos -> business observation -> Pod replacement -> business recovery -> cleanup
valid_run_rule: at least 5 baseline HTTP 200 samples, confirmed injection, replacement Pod recovery, post-recovery HTTP 200, and confirmed Chaos resource absence

api-gateway.symptom: business connection interruption during sole gateway Pod kill; recovered after replacement Pod

discovery-server.symptom: business oracle remained HTTP 200 in the valid run

api-gateway.symptom: business connection interruption during sole gateway Pod kill; recovered after replacement Pod

discovery-server.symptom: business oracle remained HTTP 200 in both valid runs

api-gateway.symptom: connection interruption and transient 500 responses during sole gateway Pod kill; recovered after replacement Pod

confirmed_issues.symptom: The sole api-gateway replica is unavailable during replacement; port-forwarded business requests observe connection interruption, and one ChaosEater run observed transient HTTP 500 responses.
confirmed_issues.root_cause_evidence: P02 Deployment has replicas=1 and no redundant gateway endpoint; PodChaos removes the only Ready endpoint before the replacement Pod becomes Ready.
confirmed_issues.recovery: Deployment creates a new Pod UID and the business oracle returns HTTP 200 after warm-up.

protected_targets.evidence: All business oracle samples remained HTTP 200 while PodChaos injected and the replacement Pod recovered.
The one valid run preserved HTTP 200; a second run was excluded because the pre-injection baseline was unstable.

excluded_runs.reason: invalid baseline or incomplete observation/recovery oracle; retained as evidence, excluded from method statistics
pre-injection business baseline became unstable before apply; no mutation was applied

environment_notes: P02 namespace has no residual PodChaos, NetworkChaos, or StressChaos resources after the batch.
The visits-service had an independent container BackOff during the batch; it was not attributed to the tested PodChaos results.
No official ChaosEater result is included because P02 has no native Skaffold input.
